name: s81lk_serdes_col_sp9b
landed_note: STW-S81-OWN7 10-21 lp8b: lp.py landed column from flat8s (spec tools/landed_parent/specs/ot_pdie_serdes_col_lp8b.json). S81-SERDES 10-19: lp.py landed column from the wires-only flat parent ot_pdie_serdes_col_flat (spec tools/landed_parent/specs/ot_pdie_serdes_col_lp4.json). Clock families (COORDINATOR LEAD-S81 10-19 11:53): clk -> ck_tx, ck_r0, ck_r1, ck_ptx, ck_rxo; pma_rck (recovered, NOT the core PLL) -> ck_syn, ck_dly, ck_chn, ck_out. The only rck->clk crossings are the CDC children u_rm (closed gray-FIFO rate matcher, elastic IDLE deletion) and u_sts (2-flop status syncs) plus the regional reset runs (>= 4 stages per region = synchronisers); no landing crosses the families. related_same_frequency is the landed-cluster STA convention (as the closed s81lk_rate_match tile); the CDC is structural, proven by tb_s81_pdie_col with die B 300 ppm slow.

reset_landing.reason: lp6 regional_reset_ports: each region's reset port rst_<r> is landed by the lp.py regional reset forest (4 registered stages on that region's own clock, beside its pin); no plain fanout from a port, no cross-region reset path

structural_change: Replace raw-pin TritonCTS with separate real physical clock spines for all five named roots. Every hard macro clock pin is a distinct leaf; actual CLOSED child boundary insertion sets its target. Physical buffers pad early PMA and parent-register branches. Original geometry, RTL, six actual landings and all data/reset ages stay identical. No300ps decoder waiver.

job.purpose: Actual child-insertion-aware physical clock trees for exact lp8b RTL; all TT/FF80ps guards retained.

job.mut_note: lp8b pad is on the sticky rm_flt status flag only (never asserted in the error-free loopback, MUT 3 cannot be observed): mutants 1, 2, 4 + region audit

cdc_note: STW-S81-OWN7 10-21: the status synchroniser is no longer a CDC child: its halves u_sts_r (ck_dec) / u_sts_t (ck_rxo) are joined by lp.py LANDINGS (lock_r / unc_r), the 2-flop stages stay behind the landing read. The rate matcher u_rm / u_rmm stays the only CDC child. lp6: rate matcher = control u_rm (ot_s81_rate_match_sr, soft CDC child: write side ck_dec, read side ck_rxo, 2-stage gray syncs) + storage u_rmm = dual-clock SRAM ot_sram_1r1w2c_16x546_m1 (raw macro sink of BOTH roots: wclk ck_dec, rclk ck_rxo; raw_macro_clocks dual form). Status sync u_sts soft CDC child (ck_r ck_dec, ck_t ck_rxo). lpk2: the landed-cluster gate refuses a HARD child whose clock pins sit on two region roots (lpk1 FAIL 'OT_LANDED: hard child u_rm clock pins on different region roots'), so the rate matcher u_rm (same RTL as the closed s81lk_rate_match tile: 8 x 512 gray-pointer elastic FIFO) and the status sync u_sts are SOFT CDC children synthesised in the parent: write side on ck_out, read side on ck_tx.
